label: Станция
description: Twelve-mission case drill for станция (station) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The base form станция is the subject of the sentence, so it stays in the nominative. Nouns in -ия keep that ending in the nominative singular.

Strategic focus: Genitive singular. After около the noun shifts to genitive станции. For -ия nouns the genitive ends in -ии, so the genitive collapses into the same form shared by the dative and prepositional singular.

Strategic focus: Dative singular. The preposition к governs the dative станции. The -ия pattern gives the dative ending -ии, making the dative singular identical to the genitive and prepositional singular.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. As the direct object of нашли, станция takes the accusative станцию; nouns in -ия change -я to -ю in the accusative singular. This is the one oblique singular that differs from the -ии cluster.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The preposition перед requires the instrumental, so станция becomes станцией with the ending -ей. Stress stays on the stem, so the ending is -ей.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. Locative на takes the prepositional станции. The -ия pattern gives the prepositional ending -ии, so it matches the genitive and dative singular exactly.

missions.phrase: Новые станции открылись в этом году.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. As the subject of открылись, the plural станции carries the nominative ending -ии instead of singular -ия. Soft nouns mark the nominative plural with -и.

missions.phrase: В нашем городе нет таких станций.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural. After нет the noun goes to genitive plural станций, a zero ending where the -и- of the stem is retained before the final й. Nouns in -ия form the genitive plural in -ий.

Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition по in its distributive sense governs the dative plural станциям, with the plural ending -ям after the stem. The plural endings are fully regular for -ия nouns.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. As an inanimate direct object of построили, станции has an accusative plural identical to the nominative plural. Inanimate feminine nouns keep accusative plural equal to nominative plural.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The preposition между governs the instrumental станциями, with the plural ending -ями. The instrumental plural ending is uniform across declensions.

missions.phrase: На дальних станциях поезд не стоит.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. After на the noun takes the prepositional plural станциях, ending in -ях. The prepositional plural ending is the same for all genders.
